title: Radiochemistry
description: Chemistry done by following radioactivity: a few atoms of a new element are found because they glow. Radium gives off a gas, radon, that decays in days. Unlocks the Decay Chamber.

puzzle.goal: Every nucleus in a collection of N has the same small chance of decaying each second, set by the half-life T. Write how many decays happen per second, A.
puzzle.name: Activity of a radioactive source
puzzle.ask: Find A in becquerels for one gram of radium-226: N = @{N} nuclei and T = @{T} seconds.
puzzle.method: The decay constant is λ = ln 2 / T, and each second λN of the N nuclei decay.
